history: Softening is active throughout settling and excavation; all retained history is preserved without reset.

cut.predicate: Reference x >= 2.2 m, over all locally occupied heights.
cut.removed_objects: Soil particles, mass, volume, and their history records.
cut.meaning: Full-height toe removal; the new vertical face is approximately 0.52 m high.

scope: Exploratory strict 2D plane-strain toe excavation; no site calibration, energy certification, or mesh-objective band width claim.

constitutive_variant.shear_driver: Sum of positive Mohr-Coulomb surface multipliers weighted by sqrt(2/3) times the deviatoric flow-direction norm; selected multi-face corner definition.
constitutive_variant.tensile_diagnostic: Sum of positive Rankine contributions inferred from invariant total plastic trace minus Mohr-Coulomb trace; diagnostic only, with fixed T0.
constitutive_variant.normalization: Single-face normalization agrees with the earlier model; no FLAC normalization claim.
constitutive_variant.post_saturation: Freeze the shear driver once strength is residual; record ambiguous zero-stress partitions without claiming uniqueness.

comparison_scope: The multi-face Mohr-Coulomb corner driver is a selected constitutive definition; comparisons to the historical combined driver do not isolate a single factor.
